Formula 1 action resumes from September 4–6 for the 2026 Italian Grand Prix at Monza. GRANDE PRÊMIO covers all paddock news live from Zandvoort with reporter Leonid Kliuev. Follow all updates on our news page.

### Drivers’ Championship Standings 2026 (Title Contenders) [...] F1 2026, PAISES BAIXOS, CORRIDA, MCLAREN, LANDO NORRIS

Lando Norris led McLaren to back-to-back victories in 2026 (Photo: McLaren)

Although Norris trails Antonelli by 83 points with roughly 11 rounds remaining, the dynamics of the title chase are shifting. Mercedes’ decision to hand Antonelli a grid penalty for a power unit change at Monza gives McLaren an immediate target to exploit. [...] ## More stories
